items.title: Should You Buy Cirrus Logic Stock Because Its Buyback Got Cheaper?
items.summary: Cirrus Logic (CRUS) stock has fallen about 27% in three months and trades roughly a third below its 52-week high. Investors are weighing a PC year that just got pushed out against a share count that keeps shrinking anyway. The buyback behind that is sturdier than the tape suggests: third in line for the cash, and still comfortably funded.

items.title: Analog Devices Wants Robots to Think Without Nvidia | Is ADI the Next Big AI Stock?
